column1: About 160 characters around the search term, which is highlighted. With "No" only the page title is shown.
column2: Približno 160 znakov okoli iskane besede, ki je označena. Pri "Ne" se pokaže samo naslov strani.

column1: Blog posts are listed with the label "Blog".
column2: Objave bloga so označene z oznako "Blog".

column1: Built %1 pages and %2 blog posts, last on %3
CMS page identifiers, one per line. A "*" at the end matches any ending (cookie*). Disabled pages and pages not assigned to the store view are never found.
column2: Identifikatorji CMS strani, ena na vrstico. Zvezdica na koncu ujame poljuben konec (cookie*). Neaktivne strani in strani, ki niso dodeljene pogledu trgovine, se nikoli ne najdejo.

column1: Excluded pages: "%1" is not a page identifier. Enter one identifier per line (letters, digits, "-", "_", "/"; "*" only at the end).
column2: Izključene strani: "%1" ni identifikator strani. Vpišite en identifikator na vrstico (črke, številke, "-", "_", "/"; "*" samo na koncu).

column1: Not available: the Magelan Blog module is not installed.
column2: Ni na voljo: modul Magelan Blog ni nameščen.

column1: Page "%1" could not be indexed. The other %2 pages are built; the reason is in var/log/magelan_searchcms.log.
column2: Strani "%1" ni bilo mogoče indeksirati. Ostale strani so zgrajene (%2); razlog je v dnevniku var/log/magelan_searchcms.log.
Strani, ki se ujemajo z vašim iskanjem

column1: Pages that could not be indexed: %1 (see var/log/magelan_searchcms.log)
column2: Strani, ki jih ni bilo mogoče indeksirati: %1 (glejte var/log/magelan_searchcms.log)

column1: Pages with less text (in characters) are left out. 0 = all pages.
column2: Strani s krajšim besedilom (v znakih) se izpustijo. 0 = vse strani.

column1: The block "Pages matching your search" on the search results page: title, excerpt with the search term highlighted, link.
column2: Blok "Strani, ki se ujemajo z vašim iskanjem" na strani z rezultati iskanja: naslov, izsek z označeno iskano besedo, povezava.

column1: The current list is replaced with a new one built from all active CMS pages. The search results page keeps working the whole time.
column2: Obstoječi seznam bo zamenjan z novim iz vseh aktivnih CMS strani. Stran z rezultati iskanja ostane ves čas delujoča.

column1: The list is updated automatically when a CMS page is saved or deleted. Rebuild it by hand only after pages were imported directly into the database.
column2: Seznam se osveži samodejno ob shranjevanju ali brisanju CMS strani. Ročna ponovna gradnja je potrebna samo po uvozu strani neposredno v bazo.

column1: The other results are under "Show all N". Phones show at most 3. Recommended: 3 to 8.
column2: Ostali zadetki so v sklopu "Pokaži vseh N". Na telefonih so vidni največ 3. Priporočeno: 3 do 8.

column1: The page search list could not be built: %1
column2: Iskalnega seznama strani ni bilo mogoče zgraditi: %1

column1: The page search list is empty, so the block finds no pages. Build it here, or run bin/magento setup:upgrade.
column2: Iskalni seznam strani je prazen, zato blok ne najde nobene strani. Zgradite ga tukaj ali poženite bin/magento setup:upgrade.

column1: Their content is in blocks or widgets, which the search does not see. They can still be found by their title.
column2: Njihova vsebina je v blokih ali pripomočkih, ki jih iskanje ne vidi. Najdejo se še vedno po naslovu.

column1: When the search finds no products, the block is always shown above the "no results" message.
column2: Ko iskanje ne najde izdelkov, je blok vedno prikazan nad sporočilom, da ni rezultatov.
